name: std::shuffle_order_engine<Engine,K>::min
intro: Returns the minimum value potentially generated by the engine adaptor. This value is equal to e.min() where e is the underlying engine.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Two engines start with seed 42. Advancing one by discard(3) matches three calls to the other.
